Manage Campus Events
& Simplify Approvals & Planning

EventSync is a Campus Event Management & Sponsorship Platform designed for SLIIT. Organizers can create, edit, and submit events for approval while administrators control the full event lifecycle from Draft → Pending → Approved → Completed. Only approved events become visible to students, ensuring structured campus activities.

Create Event
Admin Approval Panel
{/* ===== SLIDE 2 ===== */}

Register for Events
& Connect with Sponsors

Students can browse approved events and register securely with enforced capacity limits and duplicate prevention. Sponsors can explore upcoming events, apply for Gold, Silver, or Bronze sponsorship tiers.

Browse Events
Become a Sponsor
{/* ===== SLIDE 3 ===== */}

Smart QR Check-In
& Event Analytics Dashboard

Every registration generates a secure QR token linked to the event and user. Organizers can activate check-in mode and scan QR codes in real-time.

Activate Check-In
View Analytics
